verdict.rationale: Kong's AI Gateway documents MCP governance, security, observability, and autogeneration of MCP servers from REST APIs, and its Catalog can inventory MCP servers alongside APIs/agents, plus Insomnia references connecting to external MCP servers/clients. However, evidence centers on Kong acting as a gateway/governor for MCP traffic rather than a clear, hands-on flow of a user plugging arbitrary external MCP servers into Kong so it consumes their tools.
